mapper.select: select a.finprod_id AS prdId, a.finprod_abbr AS prdAbbr, a.finprod_name AS prdName, a.issue_type AS issueType, a.profit_type AS profitType, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS finprodMarketId, a.VDATE as vDate, a.MDATE AS mDate, A.PROFIT_TYPE busiType, A.P_FINPROD_ID p_prdId from FIN_PRODUCT a where a.finprod_id = #{prdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select sum(nvl(a.tdy_o_c_amt,0)) - sum(nvl(a.tdy_o_d_amt,0)) -(sum(nvl(a.tdy_o_co_c_amt,0)) - sum(nvl(a.tdy_o_co_d_amt,0))) from BOK_BALANCE a where a.bookset_id = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.balance_date = #{balanceDate,jdbcType=DATE} and a.subject_no not in ('6101', '6112') and a.subject_no like '6%' and length(nvl(a.subject_no,'')) = 4

select sum(nvl(a.tdy_o_c_amt,0)) - sum(nvl(a.tdy_o_d_amt,0)) -(sum(nvl(a.tdy_o_co_c_amt,0)) - sum(nvl(a.tdy_o_co_d_amt,0))) from BOK_BALANCE a where a.bookset_id = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.balance_date = #{balanceDate,jdbcType=DATE} and a.subject_no in ('6101', '6112')

select sum(nvl(a.O_C_AMT,0)) - sum(nvl(a.O_D_AMT,0)) from BOK_BALANCE a where a.bookset_id = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.balance_date = #{balanceDate,jdbcType=DATE} and a.subject_no in ('4103', '4104')
select CDATE from MST_HOLIDAY A inner join FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.CALENDAR_ID=B.CALENDAR_ID AND B.FINPROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.IS_HOLIDAY='1'

SELECT CASE WHEN F.PUBLISH_TYPE=#{publistType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN decode(RATE_TYPE,'01',RATE,(NVL(MI.INT_RATE, 0) * F.COEFFICIENT + F.SPREAD_RATE)*(1)/365) ELSE decode(RATE_TYPE,'01',RATE,(NVL(F.RATE_LOWER, 0) * F.COEFFICIENT + F.SPREAD_RATE)*(1)/365) END stMance , case when F.PUBLISH_TYPE=#{publistType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN (nvl(MI.INT_RATE*F.COEFFICIENT,0)+nvl(F.SPREAD_RATE,0))*100 ELSE NVL(F.RATE_LOWER,0)*100 END rateBenchmark , case when F.PUBLISH_TYPE=#{publistType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} then DECODE(RATE_TYPE,'01',L.ITEM_VALUE||TO_CHAR(RATE*100,'fm999990.00')||'%', S.ITEM_VALUE||'('||TO_CHAR(nvl(MI.INT_RATE*F.COEFFICIENT,0)*100,'fm999990.00')||'%)'||'+'||'('||TO_CHAR(nvl(F.SPREAD_RATE*100,0),'fm999990.00')||'%),即('||TO_CHAR((nvl(MI.INT_RATE*F.COEFFICIENT,0)*100+nvl(F.SPREAD_RATE,0)*100),'fm999990.00')||'%)') else S.ITEM_VALUE||'(['||TO_CHAR(NVL(F.RATE_LIMIT,0)*100,'fm999990.00')||'%'||'-'||TO_CHAR(nvl(F.RATE_LOWER,0)*100,'fm999990.00')||'%])'||'+'||'('||TO_CHAR(nvl(F.RATE_LIMIT*100,0),'fm999990.00')||'%),即(['||TO_CHAR((nvl(F.RATE_LIMIT,0)+nvl(F.SPREAD_RATE,0))*100,'fm999990.00')||'-'||TO_CHAR((nvl(F.RATE_LOWER,0)+nvl(F.SPREAD_RATE,0))*100,'fm999990.00')||'%])' end stDetail
FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO F LEFT JOIN MST_INT_RATE_INFO MI ON F.INDEX_ID=MI.INT_RATE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST L ON F.RATE_TYPE = L.ITEM_CODE AND L.DICT_CODE='RATE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST S ON F.INDEX_ID = S.item_code AND S.DICT_CODE='SECRATE_DATA'
WHERE F.BASE_RULE_TYPE=#{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and F.FINPROD_ID =#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND F.EFF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EFF_DATE <= #{bookDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) AND (MI.EFF_DATE = (SELECT MAX(MS.EFF_DATE) FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO MS WHERE MS.EFF_DATE <= #{valueDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND MS.INT_RATE_ID = F.INDEX_ID )or MI.EFF_DATE is null )

select a.finprod_id AS prdId, a.finprod_abbr AS prdAbbr, a.finprod_name AS prdName, a.issue_type AS issueType, a.profit_type AS profitType, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS finprodMarketId, a.VDATE as vDate, a.MDATE AS mDate, A.PROFIT_TYPE busiType from FIN_PRODUCT a left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ad on a.FINPROD_ID = ad.FINPROD_ID where ad.PORTFOLIO_ID= #{prdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
